verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents an API in two places. A dedicated Customer Agent API page lets customer requests come in through the API instead of a ticketing system, and the agent can run wherever you implement it. The changelog says the Internal Agent can be run from your own tools via the API. However, the evidence never shows endpoint reference docs, authentication, or coverage of configuration and management operations, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: endpoint/reference documentation, auth and SDK details, API coverage of configuration/admin actions, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
